summary: scripts/repair_check.py: failed_jobs() reads the job names under 'Failed jobs:' in an autoheal issue; check() marks each as fixed (last attempt is success), still_failing or missing (no job of that name ran); the CLI reads issue and merge request pipeline jobs from the GitLab API v4 and exits 0 ok, 1 not ok, 2 unreadable (fails closed). Standard library only; 29 tests.
